rationale: Forty-sixth pass: strengthen the target side of the worker-panic account. Reading NodeHost.Start shows its deferred recover wraps the Start call body and re-panics through panicNow when the recovered value is an error; it does not cover goroutines that workers start later. That directly supports the existing behavior entry's claim that the only target recovery sites are the error-injection step worker and NodeHost.Start, so the entry is revised to cite this anchor. The premise is unchanged.

knowledge.statement: A non-soft error returned by node.save terminates the process from the snapshot worker: ssWorker.save calls panic(err) when node.save returns an error, and neither workerMain nor handle recovers. The only recover in engine.go is installed around step workers when error injection is enabled, and NodeHost.Start's recover wraps only the body of Start and re-panics through panicNow for error values, so a snapshot save error raised later at runtime is not converted into a node-level or cluster-level error.
knowledge.conditions: A snapshot save task is executed by the snapshot worker pool, and node.doSave returns an error other than the abort-class and soft errors it handles internally.
